text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 429s from hosted inference in us-west-2. GPU hotpool saturation detected, autoscaler failing to scale. Paging on-call.
InfraBot: Autoscaler error stream: `scale_up failed: quota_check: tier_policy_mismatch` repeating. Queue depth spiked to ~42k across hotpath queues.
Sara Chen: oncall here, digging in. Observed 95th latency spike and sustained tokenbucket rejections. Putting initial mitigation suggestions.
Mike Park: Confirmed - dashboards show hotpool GPU utilization at 100% and backpressure kicking in. Token bucket drains faster than replenish for tier=standard.
Devon Patel: Looks like the autoscale lock is preventing backfill: `autoscale.lock=held` by a previous backfill job. That job completed but lock not released.
Aj Gomez: Can we temporarily route traffic to fallback model variant in eu-west-1? That reduces latency for most non-low-latency customers.
Sara Chen: Doing a quick traffic-shift plan. First: reduce token bucket drain for tier=standard from 300r/s -> 150r/s. Second: unblock autoscaler lock. Third: manual pool scale if needed.
Ops Lead: Heads-up—manual scale will cost, but customer impact is visible. CustomerEng-Beth, do we have top impacted customers list?
CustomerEng-Beth: Quick list from logs: acct-phi, acct-nimbus, acct-scribe are top three by error volume. Reached out to acct-phi already; they see ~30% errors. Telling them we're mitigating.
Sara Chen: Attempting lock release: 
```
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/autoscale/unlock?pool=hotpath-usw2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Sara Chen: unlock command returned 204. Confirming autoscaler health endpoint.
InfraBot: Autoscaler now reports healthy but last scale event failed due to policy validation: `policy=tier-standard expected quota=400 but pool_quota=0`.
Mike Park: That quota mismatch looks like a recent change in tier policies from the rollout last night. Someone bumped reserved_quota->0 for hotpool accidentally.
Devon Patel: Checking git history... found PR #4523 that adjusted tier defaults. It didn't touch hotpool but the policy evaluation script picked env var `DEFAULT_POOL_QUOTA=0` in prod.
Aj Gomez: Rolling back env override to `DEFAULT_POOL_QUOTA=500` for us-west-2 now.
Sara Chen: Applied var rollback. Triggering a manual scale-up to add 4 gpus to hotpool.
```
# manual scale
kubectl patch deployment hotpool-usw2 -p '{"spec": {"replicas": 4}}'
```
InfraBot: Manual scale accepted. New nodes provisioning. Queue depth dropping but still high (now ~12k). 429 rate down from 18% -> 8%.
Mike Park: Also applied token-bucket tune: `tier.standard.token_rate=150` and `burst=400`. Hoping to smooth token issuance and avoid sudden bursts.
Sara Chen: Confirming token issuance looks smoother on telemetry. Observed rate-limit errors now mostly from one legacy route `/v1/chat/stream`.
Devon Patel: Quick config change: exempt internal-health-checks and admin keys from token bucket while we stabilize. Pushed and reloaded policy.
Aj Gomez: Traffic shift to eu-west-1 started (10% -> 40% for non-enterprise). Should relieve pressure further.
CustomerEng-Beth: Customers updated: acct-phi says errors down to ~5% and they can continue. Will follow up with a formal incident alert email.
Ops Lead: Good. What's the current mitigation status and next actions?
Sara Chen: Mitigation status: autoscaler unlocked and healthy, pool manual-scaled +4 GPUs, token-bucket tuned, traffic partially shifted. Immediate customer impact reduced but not fully resolved.
Mike Park: Monitoring for 15-30 min. If queue <2k and 429 <1% we can start rollback traffic to normal.
Devon Patel: Postmortem notes to capture: root cause = env var override + policy validation gap + autoscale lock cleanup race. Also CD change that set DEFAULT_POOL_QUOTA without a rollout gate.
Aj Gomez: Action items (assignments):
- Sara: keep monitoring & run golden signals check (15m)
- Mike: create revert PR to remove PROD override + add validation tests
- Devon: add autoscale lock watchdog to auto-release stale locks
- Ops Lead: coordinate customer comms and SLAs
- CustomerEng-Beth: collect impact metrics per-customer for postmortem
Sara Chen: Handoff in 30m to next oncall (Mike). If anything spikes, page immediately.
IncidentBot: Incident severity elevated -> SEV3 -> owner: Sara Chen. Follow-up: link to incident bridge: https://incidents.internal/bridge/2722223333
Mike Park: A few notes for postmortem: include exact tokenbucket values before/after, PR ids (#4523, #4528), and timeline of queue depth.
Devon Patel: Agreed. I'll capture logs and attach key traces. Will schedule a 1hr post-incident review tomorrow.
CustomerEng-Beth: Thanks team. I'll send interim customer note now and include expected ETA for full recovery.
Sara Chen: Closing the thread for now but keeping watch. If stable at 0:30 we mark mitigated. :thumbsup:
